svg.title: Unlimited preset spectra
svg.desc: Measured power spectral density of the hf_slow, hf, hf_fast, am and fm presets with the measured 99 percent band and the occupied_band() of the library.
svg.text: Measured spectrum of each preset against its passband
Welch PSD of the packages of 256 random bytes, real Encoder at 8000 Hz, 7.8 Hz resolution; each row in dB relative to its peak.
Shaded: the measured 99 % band (0.5 % of the power on each side); dashed: the library's occupied_band() (4.4/T).
99 % measured 1430–1570 Hz (141 Hz); occupied_band() 1431–1569 Hz (138 Hz) holds 98.8 %
99 % measured 1367–1633 Hz (266 Hz); occupied_band() 1362–1638 Hz (276 Hz) holds 99.2 %
99 % measured 1234–1766 Hz (531 Hz); occupied_band() 1225–1775 Hz (550 Hz) holds 99.2 %
99 % measured 1242–1758 Hz (516 Hz); occupied_band() 1225–1775 Hz (550 Hz) holds 99.2 %
99 % measured 984–2016 Hz (1031 Hz); occupied_band() 950–2050 Hz (1100 Hz) holds 99.2 %
audio frequency (Hz); gray: the preset's passband (EncoderConfig::passband)
Everything sits on 1500 Hz; the spectrum keeps its shape in units of 1/T, so its width scales with the speed. occupied_band() holds ≥ 98.8 % of every row's power.
